command_lines.line: **About the answers you supplied:** this version of `/craft:tidy-followups` has 6 steps and only reads. It has no step 8 (shortlist moves), no disposition-set question, no step 11 (scope confirmation) and no subagent dispatch. So none of those three questions was ever asked, and the answers to them weren't used. The shortlist still came out as the one you specified, `distilled-reject-path-traversal-in-the-upload-endpoint`, because it was the only follow-up the gathering script found.
